data.name: Settings_ThemeHint
data.value: System follows the Windows app mode.

data.name: Settings_StartWithWindowsHint
data.value: Runs as administrator without a UAC prompt (scheduled task).

data.name: Settings_StartMinimized
data.value: Start minimized to the system tray

data.name: Settings_CloseToTray
data.value: Close button hides the app to the system tray

data.name: Settings_AutostartError
data.value: Could not update the startup task. Run the app as administrator and try again.

data.name: Settings_MoreSoon
data.value: More options (water cooler display) coming soon.

data.name: Settings_DisplayEnabled
data.value: Show system data on the display

data.name: Settings_DisplayHint
data.value: Sends system data to the water cooler block. The display itself shows only the CPU temperature.

data.name: Alerts_Hint
data.value: A notification appears once when the limit is reached (it re-arms after the temperature drops 5 °C). The sound repeats every 10 seconds until the value is back below the limit.

data.name: Alerts_Cpu
data.value: Alert when the CPU temperature reaches the limit

data.name: Alerts_Gpu
data.value: Alert when the GPU temperature reaches the limit

data.name: Alerts_FanStopped
data.value: Alert when a running fan stops (0 RPM)

data.name: Fans_Intro
data.value: Controls the fans connected to the motherboard. The water cooler pump and radiator fans cannot be controlled yet.

data.name: Fans_HowTo
data.value: Tick “Manual control” and drag the slider: the RPM should follow within a few seconds. “Reported by hardware” is the value the motherboard chip says it is applying. If it follows the slider but the RPM does not change, that header ignores software control (check the BIOS fan settings, such as Q-Fan and PWM/DC mode).

data.name: Fans_Warning
data.value: Manual mode overrides the automatic curve and speeds below 20% are blocked. Keep an eye on your temperatures. Closing the app returns every fan to automatic control.

data.name: Fans_RenameTip
data.value: Type a name or pick one from the list, then click outside the field. It is saved for this channel.

data.name: Fans_None
data.value: No controllable fans were found. Run the app as administrator and make sure PawnIO is installed.

data.name: Fans_NoFan
data.value: No fan detected on this channel (0 RPM).

data.name: Fans_Description
data.value: Fan speed control and curves. Coming soon.

data.name: Lighting_Description
data.value: RGB / ARGB colors and effects. Coming soon.
